subject: words
title: Silly words 1
about: Made-up words built from Unit 1 code (short vowels, digraphs, ck, blends) so he must sound out instead of guessing. His school's mCLASS check uses nonsense words the same way.
tip: Remind him these are pretend alien words, so the only way to read them is sound by sound. If the tablet voice says one strangely, that is fine: he is the reader here, not the voice.
